about: Cobourg is a town on Lake Ontario in Northumberland County, Ontario, east of Toronto along the Highway 401 and lakeshore corridor. A sandy beach, Victorian downtown, and marina define a classic small lakeside centre that also serves surrounding rural townships. About 20,000 people live in Cobourg.
